p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6e51a2b6.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Split on the uniform separator column; encode matching cells.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in left for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
''')
